compliance.settlement_party: Fair Share Housing Center; 143 State Street LLC; Hill Street Realty LLC; 54 West Englewood Ave LLC; Mohammed Saddiqulla; Vision 23 LLC

notes: Teaneck HEFSP originally adopted June 16, 2025; challenged by multiple parties in August 2025; settled via Settlement Agreements; 2026 Amendment incorporates 822 Palisade Ave and increases mandatory set-aside for remaining Round 3 undeveloped properties from 15% to 20%. Township received Fourth Round compliance certification. DCA obligation: Present Need = 214, Prospective Need = 431. VLA produces RDP of 11; '25% of adjusted obligation' threshold = 105 credits. Six Round 4 prospective need sites producing 83 LMI units + 41.5 bonus credits = 124.5 total credits. Unmet need (prospective) after credits = 306.5 credits. The candidate snapshot omitted 143 State St (Block 5002, Lot 26; 9 LMI), 54 West Englewood (Block 4905, Lots 1-3; 11 LMI), and 822 Palisade Ave (Block 2603, Lot 21; passive rezoning). Candidate also had Cedar Lane block/lot correct. CORRECTION: RDP in candidate was null - document confirms RDP=11.
